nameOrigin.text: Prospectors named the camp Fair Play in 1859. Local legend says a leader among the miners declared, "in this camp we'll have fair play."

founded.text: Named by prospectors as a mining camp

timeline.text: The first post office was established on August 2.
On March 26 the settlement voted to incorporate as a town to be known as South Park City.
A fire on September 26 swept through the business district and destroyed nearly fifty buildings.
The Denver, South Park & Pacific Railroad branch line to Fairplay was completed in the fall.
The Fairplay railroad station closed in April.
